meta.title: Bunker
meta.tagline: Under an ordinary hill, a hatch hides a bunker that is still active. Intact supplies, badges, dorms, and sealed areas make you realize that someone is still living down there.

strings.br.s01.title: The Silent Hill
strings.br.s01.body: The slope looks normal, but the air is colder here. Between two roots, a piece of metal sticks out, as if something had been buried in a hurry.
strings.br.s01.c1: Look for an opening along the fence
strings.br.s02.title: New Fence
strings.br.s02.body: At the base of a post, the ground is packed down as if someone still comes through here, quietly, but often.
strings.br.s02.c1: Follow the tracks and go around the bunker
strings.br.s02.c2: Go back to the starting point
strings.br.s02.c3: Look for a more hidden entrance
strings.br.s03.title: Cold Metal
strings.br.s03.body: Under the dust, a handle. The metal almost burns from how cold it is. When you pull a little, a very faint draft rises from inside.
strings.br.s03.c3: Lift it just enough to get through
strings.br.s04.title: A Long Way Down
strings.br.s04.body: You keep going deeper. The smell of earth fades away. Damp concrete takes its place, then a drier smell, almost clean. Your breathing echoes.
strings.br.s04.c3: Turn off your light and move toward the airlock by following the sound
strings.br.s05.title: The Airlock
strings.br.s05.body: Two doors. Perfect seals. A light blinks faintly. On the right, a small control box still looks like it could open the inner access.
strings.br.s05.c1: Go through the first airlock door
strings.br.s06.title: Main Hallway
strings.br.s06.body: The hallway runs straight ahead, and a cloudy glass panel protects a wall map. Farther on, closed doors, all numbered.
strings.br.s06.c1: Go to the map behind the glass
strings.br.s06.c3: Follow the dry smell toward the supplies
strings.br.s07.title: Map Display
strings.br.s07.body: The map is old but kept behind glass. One corner has been torn off. Someone wanted to take one exact piece, not destroy the whole thing.
strings.br.s07.c3: Look for the part of the map that leads to security
strings.br.s08.title: The Missing Piece
strings.br.s08.body: On the edge of the display case, there is dried glue residue. Just below it, a small mark on the wall: someone leaned here often, as if trying to memorize a path.
strings.br.s08.c1: Memorize the route before moving on
strings.br.s08.c2: Go back to the main hallway
strings.br.s08.c3: Follow the missing route toward the supplies
strings.br.s09.title: Control Room
strings.br.s09.body: A central console, black screens, a few lights still on. On the wall, a rotation schedule... dated yesterday. The bunker may not be empty.
strings.br.s10.title: Impossible Schedule
strings.br.s10.body: The names are erased, but the times are clear. Several guard shifts. Yesterday. And today. Someone here is still following a routine without showing themselves.
strings.br.s10.c1: Go back to the badge door
strings.br.s11.title: Badge Door
strings.br.s11.body: The reader is active. A light blinks softly, almost politely. On the plate, a sector name: Secondary Security.
strings.br.s11.c1: Look for a badge in the locker room
strings.br.s12.title: Service Locker Room
strings.br.s12.body: A locker stands half open. A uniform hangs inside. A faint smell of recent soap clashes with this abandoned place. In the bottom of a pocket, a badge still feels warm.
strings.br.s12.c2: Go back to the badge door
strings.br.s13.title: Quiet Beep
strings.br.s13.body: The reader accepts it. The door slides open a few inches, slowly. Beyond it, a darker room is waiting for you.
strings.br.s14.title: Untouched Supplies
strings.br.s14.body: Full shelves. Cans, water, sealed linens. Nothing has been looted. This place was not forgotten: it is maintained by someone planning to last.
strings.br.s15.title: The Empty Aisle
strings.br.s15.body: One whole row has been cleared out neatly. No mess. In its place, at the back, a metal door with no visible label.
strings.br.s16.title: Dorm in Perfect Order
strings.br.s16.body: The beds are made with exact precision. Only one is slightly sunk in. The sheet was pulled tight again in a hurry, like after an interrupted departure.
strings.br.s16.c1: Follow the clues toward the infirmary
strings.br.s17.title: Infirmary
strings.br.s17.body: Everything is neatly arranged. Bottles sorted. In a drawer left open, a cutout in the foam shows that something is missing.
strings.br.s18.title: The Missing Slot
strings.br.s18.body: Inside the drawer: one clean empty slot cut into the foam. A heavy key should have been there... and it is, stuck to the bottom, freezing in your hand.
strings.br.s18.c1: Take the key and head to the technical room
strings.br.s19.title: Technical Room
strings.br.s19.body: Pumps, filters, ducts. Everything barely vibrates. But behind the mechanical noise, another rhythm beats. Slower. More alive.
strings.br.s20.title: The Beating
strings.br.s20.body: You press yourself to the wall: the vibration comes back at regular intervals. Like breathing. It leads you to a vent grate set down on the floor, too clean to be old.
strings.br.s21.title: Filtration
strings.br.s21.body: The filters are recent. Replaced not long ago. Someone is still maintaining the air down here, as if living in this bunker is still routine.
strings.br.s21.c1: Look for where the maintenance leads
strings.br.s21.c2: Go back to the technical room
strings.br.s22.title: Sealed Door
strings.br.s22.body: Padlock. Thick metal. On the frame, a heat mark. The bunker seems to be keeping something behind this door, on purpose.
strings.br.s22.c2: Go back to the empty aisle
strings.br.s23.title: Workshop
strings.br.s23.body: A bare workbench. A few tools lined up. A note with no words: only lines, pauses, three sequences. Not a message. A procedure.
strings.br.s23.c1: Take the paper and study it
strings.br.s23.c3: Go back to the sealed door
strings.br.s24.title: The Sequence
strings.br.s24.body: On the paper, three blocks repeat with two pauses. It is not a message. It is an exact rhythm to reproduce on an interface.
strings.br.s25.title: Open Grate
strings.br.s25.body: The screws have already been removed. The grate rests right beside it, as if someone often passes through here without wanting to leave visible traces.
strings.br.s25.c2: Go back to the technical room
strings.br.s26.title: Inside the Duct
strings.br.s26.body: The air is dry. Too dry. Farther ahead, light slips under a vent plate. On the metal, repeated scraping has polished certain spots.
strings.br.s27.title: Security Room
strings.br.s27.body: Dark screens. Only one is active. The image is one second behind. Not enough to help you... just enough to make you understand that the bunker sees before you do.
strings.br.s27.c1: Walk up to the active screen
strings.br.s28.title: One Second Too Long
strings.br.s28.body: The screen shows... you. But with a slight delay. And in the image, behind you, something seems to move across the back of the hallway you just left.
strings.br.s29.title: The Cursor Moves
strings.br.s29.body: No button really responds. And yet, a cursor glides by itself across an old interface, as if guided by a routine still running. It selects one zone and stops there.
strings.br.s30.title: Observation
strings.br.s30.body: The marked area matches a sector missing from the wall map. Something exists here without ever having been officially shown.
strings.br.s31.title: Red Light
strings.br.s31.body: The red light blinks slowly. In the distance, several doors close one after another, without sound. The bunker is not panicking: it is reorganizing access and pushing you toward one exact area.
strings.br.s31.c3: Take the hallway leading to the back door
strings.br.s32.title: Back to Calm
strings.br.s32.body: The returning silence is worse. In front of you, a partially unlocked maintenance area seems to have been granted to you, like a reward or a test.
strings.br.s32.c1: Use the key on the side door
strings.br.s32.c2: Follow the faint traces in the hallway
strings.br.s33.title: Maintenance Room
strings.br.s33.body: Cleaning products, tools, gloves, and on the wall a tracking sheet. Some lines were filled in very recently, in tight, almost shy handwriting.
strings.br.s34.title: Recent Steps
strings.br.s34.body: The notes mention cleaning, rotation, and watch duty. Then one isolated word, repeated several times: sanctuary. As if the writer was trying to name the place without writing what really happens there.
strings.br.s34.c3: Force another reaction from the bunker
strings.br.s35.title: Hallway of Details
strings.br.s35.body: The hallway carries small signs: scuff marks, shifted condensation, one corner cleaner than the others. With the map in mind, you realize there is a detour... if you look closely enough.
strings.br.s35.c2: Compare the hallway to the map fragment
strings.br.s36.title: The Mark
strings.br.s36.body: On the wall, at finger height, a scuff mark appears again at regular intervals. Someone passes here often, always touching the same point to guide themselves.
strings.br.s36.c3: Go back to the previous hallway
strings.br.s37.title: The Marker Returns
strings.br.s37.body: The mark repeats all the way to an almost invisible area: one section of wall is duller, a seam in the concrete, like a carefully hidden door.
strings.br.s37.c2: Step back and look at the whole wall
strings.br.s38.title: Lived-In Room
strings.br.s38.body: An armchair. A blackout sheet. An empty glass with no dust on it. The room is not a setup: it is maintained. Someone lives here... but you always arrive after they are gone.
strings.br.s38.c1: Move closer to the sheet to see what it hides
strings.br.s38.c2: Watch longer to understand how the room is used
strings.br.s39.title: Air Runs Short
strings.br.s39.body: Your breathing becomes too loud, too warm. You feel that this place does not like human warmth. This place is cold, yes... but it also follows its own rules. And you are inside them.
strings.br.s39.c1: Look for where all this is controlled
strings.br.s39.c2: Stay and listen for a long time
strings.br.s39.c3: Go back toward the lived-in room
strings.br.s40.title: The Map Answers
strings.br.s40.body: The missing fragment comes back to mind. This hallway does not connect two areas: it goes around something the official map refused to admit. The bunker was designed to hide its true center.
strings.br.s40.c2: Go back to the hallway of details
strings.br.s41.title: Missing Area
strings.br.s41.body: The dimensions no longer match. Behind this wall, one entire volume is missing. It is not empty: it is hidden.
strings.br.s41.c1: Look for a console tied to this area
strings.br.s41.c2: Go back the way you came
strings.br.s41.c3: Force the bunker to reopen its access points
strings.br.s42.title: Central Console
strings.br.s42.body: An old terminal is waiting. No full keyboard. Only buttons, pauses, and an interface that seems made to reproduce a rhythm rather than write words.
strings.br.s43.title: Double Key
strings.br.s43.body: The console accepts the rhythm, then asks for a second element: identity or authorization. Here, secrets are protected in layers.
strings.br.s44.title: Access Granted
strings.br.s44.body: The console validates the rhythm, then the badge. One light turns green. Farther ahead, a passage that was invisible until now slowly unlocks. For the first time, the bunker lets you move forward.
strings.br.s44.c2: Check the console one last time
strings.br.s45.title: Test Mode
strings.br.s45.body: A hidden section appears. Watch settings. Isolation. Priority procedure. The bunker was not built to protect someone. It was built to contain them.
strings.br.s46.title: Priority Procedure
strings.br.s46.body: A dry procedure appears on the screen. You understand how to temporarily change the way the place works: slow access to the sanctuary, lock certain circuits, and gain a little time.
strings.br.s46.c3: Trigger an alert to open a deeper area
strings.br.s47.title: The Door Breathes
strings.br.s47.body: In front of you, the sanctuary door stays closed, but it is no longer still. A dull warmth leaks through the seals. The air around it feels heavier. The bunker is not blocking this place. It is keeping it asleep.
strings.br.s48.title: Red Antechamber
strings.br.s48.body: An empty room bathed in steady red light. Three doors take shape farther ahead, almost black. The bunker brings you here like it already knew this choice was coming.
strings.br.s48.c1: Go to the most visible door
strings.br.s48.c2: Look for a way back to the surface
strings.br.s48.c3: Study the three doors before choosing
strings.br.s49.title: Hallway of Echoes
strings.br.s49.body: The normal hallway is worse: no signal at all. You feel alone. Then you notice your steps do not match your echo. The echo lags a little behind. As if another set of steps were following.
strings.br.s49.c1: Follow the sound down the hallway
strings.br.s49.c2: Go back up to the surface
strings.br.s50.title: Shadow Without a Body
strings.br.s50.body: A shadow slides across the sheet, but no one crosses the room. You see no body, no source, no logical reflection. The bunker may not be showing you the occupant itself, only the traces left behind.
strings.br.s51.title: The Hallway Too Long
strings.br.s51.body: You keep walking, but the door never comes closer. The bunker wears you down in place. This path is not an escape: it is a loop disguised as an exit.
strings.br.s51.c1: Go back to the three doors
strings.br.s52.title: Back to the Hatch
strings.br.s52.body: The air from the surface is close, but not yet. You hear a faint sound behind you. A presence that refuses the light.
strings.br.s52.c2: Go back into the bunker and keep searching
strings.br.s52.c3: Go back down toward the area with the three doors
strings.br.s53.title: The Night Rule
strings.br.s53.body: You finally understand the rule of this place. The bunker does not react at random. It changes depending on moments of presence, watch, and rest. Everything here was organized around one occupant you rarely see.
strings.br.s53.c2: Go back to the lived-in room
strings.br.s54.title: Full Protocol
strings.br.s54.body: The bunker offers you a change in function: isolate the sanctuary, cut access, force a standby mode that no longer favors the occupant. It is not heroic. It is mechanical.
strings.br.s54.c1: Go back toward the three doors
strings.br.s54.c2: Stop the protocol and flee through the wrong hallway
strings.br.s54.c3: Go back up to the surface
strings.br.s55.title: The Last Breath
strings.br.s55.body: A cold draft finally passes across your face. The exit is close, but you feel like the bunker is only letting you go because it is done with you.
strings.br.s55.c1: Go back to the three doors to understand
strings.br.s55.c3: Go back to the red antechamber
strings.br.s56.title: The Three Doors
strings.br.s56.body: In front of you, three doors. They look alike, but each one carries a different symbol.
strings.br.s56.c1: Choose the door with the sun symbol
strings.br.s56.c2: Choose the door with the cross symbol
strings.br.s56.c3: Choose the door with the round symbol
strings.br.end_good.title: Exit at Dawn
strings.br.end_good.body: You reach the surface at first light. The hill looks ordinary again. But under your feet, you know something continues out of sight, still following its old rules.
strings.br.end_bad.title: Human Reserve
strings.br.end_bad.body: You mistake the wrong logic for an exit. The bunker takes you back without violence. One door closes. One chamber opens. Everything here was already prepared to lock you in.
strings.br.end_secret.title: The True Center
strings.br.end_secret.body: You do not just make it out alive. You finally understand what this place really is, and you close what was meant to stay closed. The bunker grows quiet. For the first time, it no longer seems to be waiting.
strings.br.h.s02.soft: There is still a human path here.
strings.br.h.s02.strong: The fence is not a boundary. It guides you toward one exact point.
strings.br.h.s07.soft: The wall map does not show everything.
strings.br.h.s07.strong: The torn piece matters more than the whole map.
strings.br.h.s08.soft: Someone memorized a path that is not shown.
strings.br.h.s08.strong: The map fragment helps reveal a hidden area.
strings.br.h.s11.soft: Some doors want a badge, not force.
strings.br.h.s11.strong: Secondary security hides a useful path.
strings.br.h.s12.soft: Someone left an access point behind them.
strings.br.h.s12.strong: The badge opens much more than one door.
strings.br.h.s15.soft: The cleared aisle is a hiding place, not a loss.
strings.br.h.s15.strong: The nameless door leads to something people avoid naming.
strings.br.h.s17.soft: The infirmary keeps an important item.
strings.br.h.s17.strong: The heavy key was not forgotten. It was waiting.
strings.br.h.s18.soft: What is missing here opens something elsewhere.
strings.br.h.s18.strong: The master key is used later, after the alert.
strings.br.h.s20.soft: The beating points to a technical route.
strings.br.h.s20.strong: The ventilation leads you to an unofficial area.
strings.br.h.s24.soft: The note is not text, but rhythm.
strings.br.h.s24.strong: The sequence is for a console, not a simple door.
strings.br.h.s26.soft: The duct goes around the official layout.
strings.br.h.s26.strong: A side exit leads to hidden maintenance.
strings.br.h.s27.soft: Security is still watching, even if the place looks empty.
strings.br.h.s27.strong: The screen and the cursor point to an area missing from the map.
strings.br.h.s30.soft: Part of the bunker exists off the map.
strings.br.h.s30.strong: Following the missing area helps you find the sanctuary.
strings.br.h.s33.soft: Someone is still maintaining this place.
strings.br.h.s33.strong: The word sanctuary appears in the recent logs.
strings.br.h.s37.soft: The seam in the wall is not a flaw.
strings.br.h.s37.strong: The marker leads to the room that is truly lived in.
strings.br.h.s42.soft: The bunker responds to rhythms, not just words.
strings.br.h.s42.strong: The terminal opens the way to the true center.
strings.br.h.s43.soft: One access point is rarely enough here.
strings.br.h.s43.strong: Badge and sequence make the sanctuary's double key.
strings.br.h.s46.soft: The override does not open everything. It reverses an advantage.
strings.br.h.s46.strong: The final procedure is meant to be used before the three doors.
strings.br.h.s56.soft: The right door depends on what you understood.
strings.br.h.s56.strong: The secret can only be reached with the truth of the protocol and the mark of the sanctuary.
strings.br.clue.has_badge.title: Badge collected
strings.br.clue.has_code.title: Sequence memorized
strings.br.clue.has_map_fragment.title: Map fragment understood
strings.br.clue.has_master_key.title: Master key collected
strings.br.clue.has_override.title: Priority procedure memorized
strings.br.clue.has_protocol_truth.title: Protocol understood
strings.br.clue.has_sanctuary_mark.title: Sanctuary mark found
